item: CNC Shield V3 kit with 4× DRV8825 drivers and heatsinks
note: Required, not optional: A4988 fails the ramp case. SIX JUMPERS: D12 and D13 on the A-axis header (gives the fourth wheel its own STEP/DIR — bridging X/Y/Z there clones another wheel instead); MS3 only under each of the four drivers for 1/16 microstepping on DRV8825 (an A4988 needs all three — most tutorials show that, and it is wrong for these). Leave EN/GND OFF so D8 controls enable. Insert each driver with its EN pin on the shield's EN mark — backwards destroys it; the trimpot sits on the opposite side from an A4988. Vref = 5 × Rsense × I — READ THE SENSE RESISTOR CODE on each carrier first: R100 → 0.75 V for 1.5 A; R200/R220 → 1.5/1.65 V. Setting 0.75 V on an R220 board gives 0.68 A and a rover that stalls. Check the kit includes jumper caps.
